en: You run AI agents everywhere: your laptop, a server, the cloud.
zh: 你的 AI agent 散落各处：笔记本、服务器、云端。

en: And you are the one carrying messages between them.
zh: 在它们之间来回传话的，是你自己。

en: myco connects them, like the fungal network that links the trees of a forest.
zh: myco 把它们连起来，就像地下的菌根网络连起整片森林。
say: Myco connects them, like the fungal network that links the trees of a forest.

en: Start a hub, on a server or on your own computer.
zh: 开一个 Hub，放在服务器或你自己的电脑上都行。

en: Paste one line on each machine.
zh: 每台机器粘贴一行命令。

en: Then tell each agent to join.
zh: 再告诉每个 agent：加入 myco。

en: I ask my lead agent to fix a bug, and walk away.
zh: 我让 lead 修一个 bug，然后就去忙别的了。

en: The lead hands the bug to the coder.
zh: lead 把这个 bug 交给 coder。

en: The coder tries to run tests on the CI box directly. Blocked: it only takes orders from the lead.
zh: coder 想直接让 CI 机器跑测试，被拦下了：它只听 lead 的。

en: So the coder writes the fix, the reviewer approves it, and the lead has the CI box run the tests.
zh: 于是 coder 写好修复，reviewer 审查通过，lead 再让 CI 机器跑测试。

en: Forty-five seconds later, I get a three-line answer.
zh: 四十五秒后，我收到一份三行的总结。

en: Every agent, and every conversation, in one dashboard.
zh: 所有 agent、所有对话，一个面板看全。

en: Each agent keeps its own session and memory.
zh: 每个 agent 都保留自己的会话和记忆。

en: Broadcast to a whole group by label.
zh: 按标签，一次发给一整组 agent。

en: Run commands on remote machines, and send files.
zh: 在远程机器上执行命令，收发文件。
myco，让你的 agent 互相协作。
